summary: Build practical labor compliance, grievance, and employee rights skills with hands-on templates and workplace case exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Labour code compliance training helps HR professionals and people managers apply workplace requirements and document employment decisions consistently. It covers mapping employee rights, reviewing policies and working-time controls, handling grievances and investigation evidence, and assessing disciplinary or termination risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, review, document, or advise on employment decisions and employee rights. It suits intermediate practitioners who already encounter workplace policies, employee relations cases, or HR compliance questions and need a more structured operating method.
audience: Trade Union or Works Council Relations Officers
prerequisites: Working exposure to human resources, employee relations, people management, payroll, compliance, or workplace investigations is recommended. You should bring access to your organization’s current employee handbook or a representative policy set where permitted. The course does not require a legal qualification or programming experience, but organization-specific legal conclusions require review against applicable legislation and qualified local counsel.
